mutations.name: Mental Mirror
mutations.description: You reflect mental attacks back at your attackers.
mutations.level_text:
When you suffer a mental attack while Mental Mirror is off cooldown, you gain +{{rules|4}} mental armor (MA).
If the attack then fails to penetrate your MA, it's reflected back at your attacker.
Cooldown: 50

mutations.description:
You can sense other mental mutants through the psychic aether.

You detect the presence of psychic enemies within a radius of 9.
There's a chance you identify detected enemies.

plan.goal: Go north along x39-41 to the north edge (y0) and cross into zone 11.20.0.1. From there head toward the Red Rock core to find the spider-like vermin or stairs down.
plan.guidance: If there's no combat, step N. Use NW or NE only if the way is blocked. Stay out of the east cluster (e7, e8 at x57-60) and away from e6 in the west (23,13). Baboon e1 is at 45,0, near the north exit. Fight it only one-on-one and only while HP is above 10. If 2 or more baboons come within 6 cells, move away from them and replan. Don't eat witchwood bark while a hostile is in view.
plan.memory: Quest (Mehmet, Joppa), What's Eating the Watervine?: Travel to Red Rock is done. Next: kill one of the spider-like vermin and bring its corpse back to Joppa. The core parcel is probably 11.20.1.1; stairs there are unconfirmed. Joppa 11.22.1.1 NPCs: Mehmet 42,19; Yrame 40,8; Ctesiphus 41,6; Tam 70,19. We're lost, so only local edge crossings work. North route from Joppa is x40 through the 11.22 zones 0.2/0.1/0.0 and 11.21 zones 0.2/0.1 (croc near x46-50, y5-6) and 0.0 (deep salty water at x30, y15-17). Entered 11.20.0.2 at 30,24. At turn 149 we were at 41,23 with full HP. Baboons at turn 149: 45,0; 0,3; 1,8; 23,13; 57,16; 60,20. A hulking baboon is somewhere unseen. Baboons throw stones for 1-3 damage and have hit only goats so far. Goats are neutral. The axe does 1d2, so avoid packs.

strategy.build_goal: Strength-based axe melee. Rely on the passives Heightened Quickness, ambient light and Mental Mirror. Dismember, Charge, Kindle and the laser need activation, which this executor cannot do.
strategy.next_upgrades: All points are 0, so hold. Next buy: Cleave (150 SP, passive). Then Endurance and Shake It Off. Put attribute points into Toughness or Strength.
strategy.resource_policy: Drink water and eat jerky only when thirsty or hungry. Witchwood bark heals but confuses, so eat it only with no enemy nearby and never in melee. Keep the unlit torches. Albino means slow daytime regeneration, so don't count on resting to heal.
